mapper.sql: SELECT t.id,t.project_id,t.title,t.description,t.status,t.priority,t.creator_id,t.assignee_id,t.due_date,t.version,t.created_at,t.updated_at, c.display_name AS creator_name,a.display_name AS assignee_name FROM task t JOIN app_user c ON c.id=t.creator_id LEFT JOIN app_user a ON a.id=t.assignee_id
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET assignee_id=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND assignee_id=#{userId} AND status!='DONE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='TODO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS todo, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS in_progress, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS done, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN due_date < #{today} AND status!='DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS overdue FROM task WHERE project_id=#{projectId}
SELECT c.id,c.task_id,c.author_id,u.display_name AS author_name,c.content,c.created_at FROM task_comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.id=c.author_id WHERE c.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY c.created_at,c.id
